gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Expressive and loud, Warnes draws its tapering strokes at a single weight with spacious tracking. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails back, so long lines of text settle into solid, tidy blocks.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Bold, stretched-out display letters up top. Warnes keeps its stroke thickness steady through every curve, while Noto Sans Old Hungarian opens its tall a, e and s wide enough to stay crisp when text gets small; a modest body size lets that show.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic sits its small letters almost level with the capitals, with curve endings kept well apart from one another. Over a long passage it reads as steady and orderly, while Warnes stays loud above it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band, its terminals flaring outward like tongs. Across a long passage it feels compact and friendly, while Warnes above it stays stout and pipe-cleaner thin.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Warnes draws its stretched, tapering strokes without any pinching at the curves, which is why it makes a bold, expressive headline. Noto Sans Old Permic does the quieter job, keeping its rounded forms open to the side with lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Noto Sans Old Persian reads lofty and light, its open counters breathing into the white space around a tall lowercase. Warnes earns its keep big and short, outlined at one steady thickness.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Noto Sans Old Sogdian stands tall, its x-height nearly reaching the capitals. Warnes is best at loud, marker-traced headlines with spacious tracking, while the wide-mouthed sans-serif letters of the body stay crisp even when shrunk.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic reads chunky and friendly, with open-mouthed curves that stay clear on a tall lowercase. Warnes brings the pipe-cleaner strokes and wide tracking, and the pair's strongest quality is how loudly one speaks and how plainly the other answers.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Expressive from the first letter. Warnes looks drawn with a single nib and sprawls with spacious tracking, while Noto Sans Oriya keeps generous gaps in its curves and small letters nearly as tall as the capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-osage: Noto Sans Osage fills each line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up. Its strongest quality is how softly it sits beneath Warnes, whose strokes never vary.
